svg.data-weight: 9.4 kg (20.6 lbs) (guide Table 1); the data sheet says 20.6 lbs (9.36 kg)
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 4.4 x 46.7 cm (19 x 1.75 x 18.4 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
svg.data-ports-max-speed: eight ports of 100 Gbps; 16 of 50 Gbps; 8 of 40 Gbps; 16 of 25 Gbps; 64 of 10 Gbps; 48 of 1 Gbps
svg.data-power-measure: guide Table 4 typical and maximum, which the data sheet repeats; typical measured at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports, excluding transceivers (data sheet)
svg.data-storage-temp: -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2); the data sheet says -40 to 70 C
svg.data-rj45: 48 x 1/2.5/5/10GBASE-T RJ-45, up to 30 m over Cat6a (data sheet)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G and 40G, in the eight QSFP100 cages (data sheet)
svg.data-console: RJ-45 RS-232 serial on the rear
svg.data-oob: one 10/100/1000 management port on the rear
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear
svg.data-certifications: BSMI, CE, KCC, NRTL, RCM, UKCA, VCCI, TEC, ANATEL, ICASA, NOM Equivalency (data sheet)
